seo.title: Contact DNH | Request an Advisory Conversation
seo.description: Share the financial issue or decision you are facing for an initial, confidential review by the DNH team.

hero.title: Define the financial question.
hero.description: Use this form to outline your situation, decision context, and the support you are seeking. It is not a channel for trading signals or instant investment recommendations.
hero.qualification: Each enquiry is reviewed for scope and fit before a member of the team follows up.
hero.imageAlt: A professional financial advisory conversation at DNH

information.title: Clear channels for a considered first conversation
information.notice: The details below are sample data only and must be replaced with verified DNH contact information before launch.
information.confidentiality: Submitted information is used only to assess your enquiry and arrange an appropriate follow-up. Please do not include passwords, banking credentials, or unnecessary sensitive data.

process.title: From initial context to an appropriate next step

steps.title: Outline the issue
steps.description: Briefly describe the decision, its context, and what you expect from an advisory conversation.

steps.title: Initial review
steps.description: We assess the enquiry for subject matter, urgency, and fit with DNH's advisory scope.

steps.title: Relevant follow-up
steps.description: Where there is a potential fit, we will coordinate the appropriate format and timing for the next conversation.

form.title: Start by giving us the decision context.
form.description: A concise initial brief helps us frame the issue correctly before contact and makes the first conversation more focused.
